summary: The registrant, WhiteHawk Minerals Corp., filed a Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing a private placement of 2,873,563 shares of Class A common stock at $26.10 per share, yielding approximately $75.0 million in gross proceeds. The company is the issuer, and Raymond James & Associates and Stifel, Nicolaus & Company served as placement agents. The shares are exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. A related Registration Rights Agreement requires a resale registration statement filing within 45 days of the September 21, 2026 expected close. Proceeds will fund acquisitions and general corporate purposes. This is a financing, not a special situation.
